name: Worst-Slice Mining & Targeted Adaptive Attack Discovery
status: PHASE F — IMPLEMENTED, PENDING INDEPENDENT AUDIT

F1.name: Worst-Slice Discovery
F1.purpose: Identify detector weak spots via multi-dimensional slice mining

F2.name: Random Attack Baseline
F2.purpose: Evaluate performance against independent non-targeted attacks

F3.name: Targeted Attack Generation
F3.purpose: Generate targeted adversarial attacks from Top-5 discovered slices for hardening

F4.name: Targeted Hardening
F4.purpose: Retrain detector using targeted adversarial samples

F5.name: Unseen Targeted V2
F5.purpose: Primary unseen generalization evaluation against intensified slice attacks

F-D2.name: Random Attack Baseline
F-D2.purpose: Difficulty baseline of non-targeted randomly generated attacks

F-D3.name: Targeted Adversarial Hardening Set
F-D3.note: 50% fraud is an adversarial hardening distribution, not realistic payment traffic

F-D4.name: Unseen Targeted V2 Test
F-D4.purpose: Primary final generalization dataset (evaluation-only, isolated from discovery and training)

G1.name: Slice Improvement
G1.rule: FNR_hardened < FNR_baseline on >= 4 of 5 discovered slices

G3.name: FPR Protection
G3.rule: On F-D4, Hardened FPR must not increase by > +1.0 percentage point

G4.name: Random Attack Preservation
G4.rule: On F-D2, Hardened recall must not decrease by > 2.0 percentage points
